'''Bakishan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Constable/Legends|constable]] for the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Bakishan lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].A [[Constable/Legends|constable]] for the city of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], he was stymied by a string of robberies. The thieves had even stolen the state-of-the-art police surveillance [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]] that he had set up to catch them.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameLS}}
He asked a Republic-allied individual to help stop the group, which Bakishan suspected was actually a group of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]]. Astromech droids had been seen at every robbery, and no one was able to identify the thieves themselves. The individual recovered a transmitter from one of the droids and followed the trail to [[Izink]], a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] outside of Anchorhead. The individual convinced the Jawa to turn himself in to Bakishan, ending the string of thefts.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bakishan was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He gives Republic players the Tatooine mission "Astromenace", where Bakishan asks the player to investigate a string of robberies.<ref name="TOR" />
